d: International students are turning away from the US and UK, with stricter visa policies and limited post-study job opportunities pushing them towards continental Europe and Asia. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia is looking to China for diplomatic support as Houthi attacks threaten its oil infrastructure and regional security. With Washington reluctant to confront the Houthis militarily, Beijing is expanding its engagement across West Asia. Are shifting policies reshaping global education choices and geopolitical alliances?
